How the AI resume builder works

  1. 1. Describe your background. Paste an old resume or type rough notes — job titles, dates, wins, education.
  2. 2. AI structures and writes it. Gemini turns your notes into quantified achievement bullets, a summary and a keyword-rich skills list.
  3. 3. Pick a template and edit. Switch designs instantly; every field stays editable in the form.
  4. 4. Download. Export a print-perfect A4 PDF, or a plain-text version for job boards that only accept pasted text.

Want a score before you apply? Run the finished resume through the free ATS resume checker.
